items.notes: First listing in this dataset whose product page uses the words 'solid gold' ('Solid Gold' badge; 'set in 14K solid gold or platinum'). Spec table also states 'Rhodium Plating: Yes: Diamond area' — a rhodium finish over the diamond area, recorded verbatim and separate from the solid-gold metal claim. Page shows both 'In stock. Ships out in 3-5 days.' and a 'Sold out' state; availability is not resolved from the text. Buy-box marks 'Final Sale — This product is non-returnable' while advertising '100 Day Returns' (F-016), so the receive-test-return sequence cannot be followed for this ring as listed. 0.620 CTW total / 0.50 CTW center per spec table.
